name: shadow-portfolio
description: SHADOW — Video Editor & Motion Designer Portfolio

scripts.postinstall: cd platform/backend && npm install --include=dev && npx prisma generate
scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('platform/frontend/dist')){fs.cpSync('platform/frontend/dist','admin',{recursive:true}); console.log('Admin assets synced to root/admin');}"
scripts.build:all: npm install && cd platform/backend && npm install && npx prisma generate && npx tsc && cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd ../.. && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('platform/frontend/dist','admin',{recursive:true});"
